ctx.x: That was, that was, Joe played with me and the, the sick, uh, the sick, uh, the sick, uh, Tundell. Tundell. In the Tundell Brass Band, yeah. Ever hear of the Security Band? Sure. What band was that? Across the River, Security. Who played in it?
